title: Unearthed
description:
S10 E05 — Rise of Egypt's Sun Kings
The ancient necropolis of Abusir contains strange megastructures unlike any discovered in Egypt; experts gain rare access to investigate lost tombs and forgotten rituals to reveal the secrets of Egypt's Sun Cult pharaohs.

title: Unearthed
description:
S10 E04 — Secrets of Hadrian's Villa
Hadrian's Villa is the largest Roman palace ever constructed and demonstrates the opulent peak of Rome's ancient engineering; experts investigate secrets that could reveal the truth behind one of Rome's most enigmatic emperors.

title: Unearthed
description:
S10 E10 — Lost Tomb of Alexander the Great
The magnificent tomb of Alexander the Great mysteriously vanishes and becomes a legend; using CGI, investigators piece together the evidence to reveal where his tomb lies and what it might look like.

title: Unearthed

Along with Pompeii, the devastating eruption of Mount Vesuvius left another mysterious Roman settlement buried beneath its ashes; experts reveal new evidence of an ancient civilization and history's most infamous disaster.

description:
S10 E02 — Enigma of the Red Pyramid
The Red Pyramid at Dahshur is a revolutionary megastructure and the first true pyramid ever constructed in Ancient Egypt; experts investigate to reveal the pharaoh who built it and the mystery behind its trailblazing design.

title: Unearthed
description:
S10 E11 — Sunken City of Helike: The Hunt for the Real Atlantis
In 373 B.C., the Greek city of Helike vanished; archaeologists believe they've found the ruins of the great lost metropolis; using CGI, experts re-create the city's final moments and reveal its links to the greatest lost land of all -- Atlantis.

title: King Tut: A Century of Secrets

description:
S06 E04 — Pluto's Evil Twin
After NASA's New Horizons spacecraft flies by Pluto, it encounters a strange alien world that shuts down the probe's computers; experts investigate if the mysterious object is an alien spacecraft hiding at the edge of the solar system.

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S06 E08 — Did Aliens Nuke Mars?
A strange discovery by NASA's Mars Curiosity rover suggests the Red Planet was home to an alien nuclear war 300 million years ago; experts investigate if an extraterrestrial Armageddon transformed an Earth-like world into a wasteland.

description:

description:

Cosmic rays capable of destroying human DNA are hurtling through outer space like subatomic bullets, causing space crews radiation damage.

Stel and Jess trek to the Black Sea, where they investigate a 7,000-year-old skeleton buried in gold treasure, and uncover evidence of an ancient catastrophe that could be the basis for Noah's flood and the destruction of Atlantis.

Stel and Jess search underwater ruins off the coast of Greece that could be the ruins of Atlantis.

title: Hunting Atlantis

Stel and Jess investigate a mysterious Greek island where an advanced ancient civilization built a massive marble pyramid.

title: Hunting Atlantis

Stel and Jess dig into unexplored archeological sites along the Adriatic coast of Croatia where underwater relics from an ancient bridge system lead them to an age-old legend of a lost city and into a massive sinkhole that could swallow a city whole.

title: Hunting Atlantis
description:

Stel and Jess sail to Sicily to explore Europe's largest active volcano; their investigation leads them to a hidden labyrinth and a mysterious underwater monolith.

Stel and Jess investigate cave paintings in Turkey that match an advanced civilization that built the world's oldest city; tracing the ancient migration to the coast, they discover a shoreline and ruins of a lost city right under their feet.

description:
S01 E01 — Buried Beneath Jerusalem
Lost for centuries, scholars believe the Ark of the Covenant never left Jerusalem and remains buried beneath this ancient city; now, a pioneering team of archaeologists is on a quest to unearth the most famous and treasured artifact in human history.

title: Secrets of the Lost Ark
description:
S01 E02 — Heist in the Holy Land
Ancient documents and legends suggest that the Ark of the Covenant may have been stolen by Roman legions and hidden in Rome; a team of archaeologists explores mystery cults and ancient catacombs to uncover the truth behind this treasured artifact.

title: Secrets of the Lost Ark
description:
S01 E06 — The Doomsday Curse
Ancient scriptures describe the Ark of the Covenant as possessing an almighty force with the capacity to kill; now, an expert team of archaeologists traces the ark's destructive path in a quest to discover the truth behind its mythical power.

title: Secrets of the Lost Ark
description:
S01 E04 — The Jeremiah Code
According to biblical scripture, the prophet Jeremiah hides the Ark of the Covenant at a remote location for safekeeping; a team of archaeologists investigates sacred sites and ancient tombs to retrace the possible journey of this lost artifact.

title: Secrets of the Lost Ark
description:
S01 E05 — Legend of the Knights Templar
The holy order of the Knights Templar are believed to have located and seized the Ark of the Covenant centuries ago; now, expert historians follow the trail of this elusive order to uncover the truth behind this sacred relic's mysterious journey.

title: Secrets of the Lost Ark
description:

Earth's history is marked by one cosmic disaster after another, forging the path of human evolution; now, experts explore how the Earth has teetered on the verge of destruction.

As the two Voyager spacecraft reach interstellar space, experts explore their astonishing discoveries and how their extended operation has transformed into the ultimate mission.

Uranus and Neptune are mysterious, icy worlds at the edge of the solar system; new discoveries reveal that these strange planets may have helped start life on Earth.

description:
S01 E06 — To Catch a UFO
When a U.S. Air Force intercept aircraft chases after a UFO, it vanishes forever without a trace; a new investigation tries to uncover what caused this mysterious disappearance.

description:
S01 E03 — Soviet Doomsday Warning
A Russian radio station has broadcast a signal nonstop since the Cold War, and no one knows why; experts use hi-tech methods to investigate what it is and what might happen if it ever stops.

title: Phantom Signals
description:
S01 E05 — The Ghost on the Radio
When someone picks up a radio distress call from a seven-year-old boy lost alone in the desert, authorities embark on a search-and-rescue mission to find him; as the hunt continues, the case becomes more and more mysterious.

title: Phantom Signals
description:
S01 E07 — Omen of the Pharaoh's Wail
Experts use cutting-edge technology to investigate a mysterious phenomenon at the tomb of a 3,000-year-old Egyptian pharaoh.

title: Phantom Signals
description:
S01 E02 — Alien Evidence: The Holy Grail
When a powerful radio beam originating from deep space is detected by experts on Earth, some suspect it's hard evidence of extraterrestrial life; new investigations into this shocking signal might reveal the truth.

title: Phantom Signals
description:
S01 E01 — Curse of the Lost Cosmonaut
When two experts build their own radio-listening station to intercept the secret communications of American and Soviet astronauts, they capture traces of a haunting voice that may be a lost Russian cosmonaut.

title: Strange Evidence
description:
S05 E01 — Door to the Undead
Security guards patrolling the basement of an empty municipal building are shocked when they encounter a door repeatedly opening and violently slamming shut; experts investigate a connection to black magic rituals and the building's disturbing past.

title: Strange Evidence
description:
S05 E02 — The Exorcist Effect
A boy who can turn his head 180 degrees and face directly behind him resembles infamous accounts of demonic possession from horror films; experts use cutting-edge technology to find out what's giving him this extreme ability.

title: Strange Evidence
description:

A close encounter with an enraged ape-like creature is caught on camera, experts investigate if it's evidence of a once-extinct Neanderthal specimen engineered by a nearby experimental research facility.

description:

description:

With more than 80 moons, Saturn could rank among the most dynamic planetary system in Sol's neighborhood; with its giant underground oceans and protective magnetic fields, experts explore how Saturn's moons offer new insight into the Solar System.

Dark Matter is thought to be the cosmic glue that holds the universe together, yet the search for it continues to eluded scientists today.

Alaskan engineers build a massive dam to power an entire town; the world's largest helicopters; Alaska's largest boat lift hauls a 400-ton fishing ship in high winds.

A ship built to endure tsunami size waves travels on a highway unlike any other in North America; a fleet of machines combats a huge flood in the Arctic Circle; the biggest, most powerful wind turbines in Alaska.

The Yeti, a machine with 588 sharp teeth, helps keep an airport running; tugboats break the ice in an Alaskan port; soldiers stationed at the coldest army post in the US.
